notes.content:
Improved enemy behavior.
Fixed a bug where the elevator mechanism would activate even when conditions were not met.

Implemented the scene unlock button. Scenes can be unlocked from the settings in the title screen.
Adjusted image size in some documentation.
Changed some text.
Lowered the default mouse sensitivity.
Scene 4

Modified some collision areas.
Scene 5

Fixed a bug where bones would behave abnormally.

Scene 2
Enlarge the detection area of the elevator switch
Fixed a bug where the player could still be caught by enemies after reaching the goal

Scene3.
Fixed a bug that caused the conversation to return when riding on the swing at certain times.

Changed behavior when a character approaches a wall.
Some document layouts have been adjusted.

Scene1
Increased bullet refill positions
Scene4
Changed some MAP structures
The game no longer switches to normal clearing after acquiring certain items.

Scene3.

Fixed a bug that caused certain items to burn and disappear
